'''High Stakes and Hyperspace''' was a gambling den located on a hangar deck level of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The interior of the den contained [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidscreens]] which provided the only lighting and showed [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]] racing and [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] matches for viewers to bet on, as well as tables for [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] or [[Chance cube/Legends|chance cubes]]. At the tables [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitresses]] took orders for drinks from customers and set up the games. The den's bookie was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] named [[Jokol]] who also took drink orders as well as wagers from customers, with whom he often made gruff small talk if they were betting.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
High Stakes and [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] was first introduced in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] in [[2013]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The den was a location players could potentially visit while searching for information during the first episode of the game.
